body.purpose: Prose, snippets, and helper copy at about 65ch.

label.purpose: Buttons, nav links, metadata, counts, kind stamps. Always mono, always uppercase.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one stamped action per view, reserved for Search.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Greenbar Band action for Load more and similar moves.

components.name: Outlined Danger Button
components.description: Inline error recovery next to a failed action; stamp outline, fills stamp on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 6px 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-stamp, oklch(0.48 0.17 15)); border: 1px solid var(--color-stamp, oklch(0.48 0.17 15)); border-radius: 0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--color-stamp, oklch(0.48 0.17 15)); color: var(--color-card, oklch(0.978 0.015 132)); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-stamp, oklch(0.48 0.17 15)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input

components.html: <input class="ds-input-search" type="search" placeholder="the part where he parks the bike at night" />
components.css: .ds-input-search { width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; background: var(--color-card, oklch(0.978 0.015 132)); color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.27 0.045 145)); border: 1px solid var(--color-ink, oklch(0.27 0.045 145)); border-radius: 0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 14px; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 0 var(--color-rule, oklch(0.76 0.04 132)); transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: var(--color-ink-soft, oklch(0.43 0.04 145)); } .ds-input-search:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-stamp, oklch(0.48 0.17 15)); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 0 var(--color-stamp, oklch(0.48 0.17 15)); } .ds-input-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-stamp, oklch(0.48 0.17 15)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-card-moment { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; background: var(--color-card, oklch(0.978 0.015 132)); color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.27 0.045 145)); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-ink, oklch(0.27 0.045 145)) 80%, transparent); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 0 var(--color-rule, oklch(0.76 0.04 132)); text-decoration: none; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-card-moment:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 0 var(--color-stamp, oklch(0.48 0.17 15)); } .ds-card-moment:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-stamp, oklch(0.48 0.17 15)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-thumb { position: relative; display: block; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: var(--color-paper-deep, oklch(0.9 0.05 132)); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-rule, oklch(0.76 0.04 132)); } .ds-card-time { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; padding: 2px 8px; background: var(--color-card, oklch(0.978 0.015 132)); border-left: 1px solid var(--color-rule, oklch(0.76 0.04 132)); border-top: 1px solid var(--color-rule, oklch(0.76 0.04 132)); font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card-body { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 14px; } .ds-card-name { font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 14px; } .ds-card-snippet { color: var(--color-ink-soft, oklch(0.43 0.04 145)); font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.4; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; }

components.name: Notice Card
components.description: Dashed empty, error, or idle panel. Stamp border variant for failures.
components.html:
Ask for a moment in plain language

Transcript and visual search are fused, so quoted speech and described scenes both land in the same catalog.
components.css: .ds-notice { padding: 32px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-card, oklch(0.978 0.015 132)) 70%, transparent); border: 1px dashed var(--color-rule, oklch(0.76 0.04 132)); border-radius: 0; } .ds-notice-title { margin: 0; color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.27 0.045 145)); font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-notice-body { margin: 8px 0 0; max-width: 36rem; color: var(--color-ink-soft, oklch(0.43 0.04 145)); font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-notice-danger { border-color: var(--color-stamp, oklch(0.48 0.17 15)); } .ds-notice-danger .ds-notice-title { color: var(--color-stamp, oklch(0.48 0.17 15)); }

narrative.overview:
shotgrep's web app is an archive box lined with greenbar ledger paper: continuous-form ruling, index cards, ink lines, and an oxblood stamp for the one thing that matters. The product is a catalog for footage, so the interface borrows the materials of a working archive rather than the chrome of a SaaS dashboard. Density is a feature: cards sit close, timecodes are always visible, and the page never performs.

The system is product register, so familiarity wins where it counts. The search field looks like a search field, the player keeps native controls, and results render at full density with no reveal animation. The archival character comes from material choices (ruled paper, hard offset shadows, mono data) and never from novel affordances.

What it rejects, per PRODUCT.md: dark SaaS dashboards with purple gradients and glass cards, neon terminal cosplay, Netflix-style poster rows, AI-brand gradient text, and skeuomorphism as costume. The paper here is a surface, not a costume. No texture fights readability, and nothing pretends to be leather.
keyCharacteristics: Greenbar paper surfaces (hue 132-145) with a 28px ruling and a subtle SVG grain, never pure white or untinted grey.
Oxblood Stamp on under 10% of any screen: the primary action, focus rings, hover shadows, and kind stamps.
Hard, unblurred offset shadows (2-6px) as the only elevation; presses physically sink by the offset.
Square corners everywhere except the icon tile.
Numbers always in IBM Plex Mono with tabular figures.
No motion beyond 150ms state feedback; no entrance choreography.

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Oxblood Stamp covers under 10% of any screen. If two stamp-red elements compete for attention, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is tinted green (hue 132-145). Pure black, pure white, and untinted grey are forbidden.

rules.name: The Greenbar Rule
rules.body: The page surface carries the 28px ruling (Greenbar Band at 55%) under the grain. Cards, inputs, and the player stay solid Index Card, so content never sits on the ruling.

rules.name: The Icon Export Rule
rules.body: The SVG favicon hardcodes sRGB equivalents (paper #E6F4DC, ink #182C18, stamp #A8203D) because the icon pipeline does not accept OKLCH. OKLCH stays canonical everywhere else.

rules.name: The Mono For Numbers Rule
rules.body: Timecodes, durations, fps, codecs, counts, and scores are always IBM Plex Mono with tabular figures. A number set in Archivo or Fraunces is a bug.

rules.name: The Italic Is A Voice Rule
rules.body: Fraunces italic appears twice only: asset names on cards, and the single emphasized word in the hero. Body copy is never italic.

rules.name: The Uppercase Is A Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase text is always mono, always letter-spaced, and never longer than a short label.

rules.name: The No Blur Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is Npx Npx 0 0 color. A blurred shadow is a bug.

rules.name: The Press Rule
rules.body: On :active, a pressable element translates by exactly its shadow offset and drops the shadow, so it sinks into the page. Buttons press 3px, small buttons 2px, and nothing ever scales.

dos: Do tint every neutral green (hue 132-145) and keep the page on Greenbar Paper with its ruling and grain.
Do use IBM Plex Mono with tabular figures for every number.
Do keep shadows hard and offset (2-6px, zero blur) and make presses sink by exactly the offset.
Do use 2px Graphite Ink rules for page structure and 1px ink borders for controls.
Do keep Oxblood Stamp under 10% of the screen: one primary action, focus rings, hover shadows, kind stamps.
Do keep the results grid at 1/2/3 columns with a 20px gap and let cards stay dense.
donts: Don't ship dark SaaS dashboards: zinc-950 surfaces, purple/blue gradients, glow accents, generic glass cards.
Don't do neon terminal cosplay: green-on-black, CRT scanlines, blinking cursors as decoration.
Don't build Netflix-style streaming UI: poster rows, autoplay trailers, hero carousels.
Don't use AI-brand gradient text, sparkle icons, or "Powered by AI" badges.
Don't use skeuomorphism as costume: leather textures, fake stitched borders, drop-shadowed photographs.
Don't blur a shadow, round a corner (the icon tile is the only exception), or use pure #000 or #fff.
Don't set a number in a non-mono face or a label in Fraunces.
Don't animate beyond 150ms state feedback: no entrance choreography, no scroll-driven motion.
